define_G: create a generator network using define_G with type global, local, encoder, or vaencoder
define_D: build a multiscale discriminator using define_D with instance or spectral normalization
GANLoss: create a GAN loss module using GANLoss with lsgan or BCE loss
VGGLoss: build a VGG perceptual loss module using VGGLoss for image comparison
print_network: print a network architecture and total parameter count using print_network
